_description: Constants that materially change behaviour but have no config path - they are hardcoded in the modules named by each _source key. Values here mirror the source as of this commit; changing this file alone has no effect until the corresponding module reads from it. Entries that became real config keys have moved to env_config.json / train_config.json.

action_space._note: Structural, not tunable. category_n is hardwired to the if/elif mapping in _set_action_mkt_depth, and price_offset_n to `offset_multiplier = price_offset - 1`; changing either number without changing that logic does nothing.

observation_layout._note: Book depth is one concept stored in four places: K_ROWS here, price_n in the action space, and two literal .reshape(4, 10) calls in action_helper.py (lines 256, 266). All four are 10 today so behaviour is correct; any change raises ValueError/IndexError until they are de-duplicated. Promoting depth to env_config.json is blocked on that.

price_anchor_fallbacks._note: Two independent fallbacks for last_price, both overwritten by reset(). Neither is worth exposing, but they should agree.

module_id_prefixes._note: A naming contract SelfPlayCallback parses, not a knob.
